sub_sector.value: plasma-derived immune globulin therapies; plasma collection; contract manufacturing (CDMO)

healthcare_segment.detail: End-to-end biopharmaceutical producer of plasma-derived specialty biologics, with plasma collection and CDMO services.

product_stage.detail: Sells three FDA-approved immune globulin products commercially.

customer_payer.detail: Products reimbursed via payers and administered by providers; CDMO services sold to other drug developers.

therapeutic_area.detail: Immune globulins for immune-compromised patients and prevention of infections, including primary humoral immunodeficiency and hepatitis B.
